subject: Docs Quickstart: Request for technical demo - scheduling

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Docs Quickstart - interested in technical demo

Hi Marissa,

I was following the Docs quickstart for Redwood and would love a technical deep-dive on inference performance, batching and private deployment options. We're evaluating inference runtimes for low-latency features and I want to bring my infra team in.

I'm based in PST and generally available next week Tue/Wed afternoon (PST). Can you connect me with someone for a 45-60m technical demo?

A few bullet items we'd like covered:
- end-to-end inference latency at 1k concurrent users
- autoscaling + cold start behavior on Dedicated
- KV cache and prefix caching details
- quantization/throughput tradeoffs for Mistral-sized models

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Platform Engineer, Acme Analytics
alex.chen@acme.ai

Hi Alex - great to meet you and glad the quickstart was useful. Happy to set up a technical session with our solutions engineer (cc'd).

We can do a 45m deep-dive covering the bullets you listed. A couple of proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-23 2:00-2:45pm
- Wed 2026-03-24 10:00-10:45am
- Wed 2026-03-24 3:00-3:45pm

If none of those work, tell us a couple times that do and we'll find a fit. I'll also attach a short mutual action plan so we can capture goals and any prep we should do.

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m intros + context
2) 20m deep dive: serving runtime, caching, and kernels
3) 15m demo: live request path + autoscale scenario
4) 5m next steps / follow-ups

Attaching: mutual-action-plan.pdf.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
